propositions: The citation documentation does not explicitly state that the required edge between tickets must be DIRECT, creating a footgun where transitive/indirect dependencies are mistakenly believed to satisfy the citation requirement.
The verifier det_citation._edge_verified correctly implements direct-edge-only checks with no recursion, but the shipped documentation does not reflect this constraint.
A transitive dependency on a cited ticket (e.g., a config ticket) does not satisfy the citation requirement and will be treated as edge-unbacked, failing the citation silently.
The fix requires updating the citation section in docs/writing-a-passing-plan.md to explicitly clarify that the edge must be DIRECT and that transitive/indirect dependencies do not count.
